facts.fact: Veronica 是真名，她的化名是 Candie X. KANDINSKY；KRAY 的真名是 Nick。
facts.anchor: Veronica was her true name. Her pseudonym was Candie X. KANDINSKY.

facts.fact: KRAY 给 Veronica 看从 Wacker 办公室顺来的中情局挑战币，自称是「借」。
facts.anchor: He showed Veronica Wacker’s Agency challenge coin.

facts.fact: Veronica 曾在当模特赚学费期间近距离见识过各种职场厚黑手段。
facts.anchor: she had studied cutthroat workplace politics up close in her time paying for college as a fashion model

facts.fact: 人事部门把 CIA 全员真名名单误传真到摩纳哥，一周后潘内塔局长收到亲王 Albert 亲笔信提醒。
facts.anchor: A week later a DHL package arrived for Director Panetta with a copy of the list of true names and a handwritten note from Prince Albert himself

facts.fact: Veronica 刚在哥本哈根结束 TDY，成功招募了第一个特工 MCFASTRIDE/4（丹麦央行人士）。
facts.anchor: she had finalized the recruitment of her first agent, MCFASTRIDE/4, this Danish central banking guy

facts.fact: ZOTZ 是 Veronica 在 CIA 最好的朋友，来自南达科他州苏福尔斯。
facts.anchor: ZOTZ, an attractive blonde from Sioux Falls, South Dakota, was Veronica’s best friend at CIA

facts.fact: 面对培训主管的性骚扰，ZOTZ 把呕吐物吐了他一身，下车打车回基地，还留下了那只后来被证明是假货的 Rolex。
facts.anchor: She threw up all over him, got out of the car, and took a taxi back to Base. And she kept the Rolie, which of course turned out to be a fake

facts.fact: 章中 Veronica 举杯提议「外派就待在外派」，KRAY 应和。
